rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something happening frequently or repeatedly.

example.english: I frequently forget to bring my keys.
example.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 jat6 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 so2 si4

rows.note: Choose this for a more neutral or formal statement about something happening frequently.

example.english: The company frequently arranges training for employees.
example.traditional: 公司經常安排員工培訓。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 ging1 soeng4 on1 paai4 jyun4 gung1 pui4 fan3

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that something happens on many occasions rather than at every occasion.

example.english: I frequently take the bus to work.
example.traditional: 好多時我都會搭巴士返工。
example.jyutping: hou2 do1 si4 ngo5 dou1 wui5 daap3 baa1 si6 faan1 gung1
